tasks.title: Log rate
tasks.statement: The PID loop runs at **{f} Hz**, `blackbox_sample_rate` = 1/**{d}**. At what rate is the log written, Hz?
tasks.solution: Log rate = PID rate × `blackbox_sample_rate`: at 8 kHz and 1/4 — 2 kHz, at 3.2 kHz (BMI270) and 1/2 — 1.6 kHz. 1 kHz is enough for basic PID analysis, noise and filters need 2 kHz (1.6 kHz for the BMI270).

tasks.title: How long the flash lasts
tasks.statement: Onboard flash of **{m} MB**, a Blackbox data rate of **{r} KB/s**. After how many seconds of recording will the memory be full (1 MB = 1024 KB)?
tasks.solution: Time = capacity / data rate = m · 1024 / r. For 16 MB at 60–100 KB/s that is 273–164 s, the “3–4 minutes” from the theory; 2 MB of flash at 80 KB/s fills up in 26 s. The 3 % tolerance covers a calculation with 1 MB = 1000 KB.
